players.product: Atlas and Origin agentic target-to-antibody discovery platform

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Zach Jonasson: the interim SAD safety data released in June 'looked clean', and human-genetics case reports of people with loss-of-function mutations in prolactin or its receptor, healthy apart from females being unable to lactate, support the mechanism's safety. CEO Sean McClain: HMI-115's Phase II data showed efficacy in endometriosis at the highest dose; given ABS-201's receptor occupancy he believes Absci can achieve that efficacy and a greater decrease in overall pain. CEO: Absci's UK Biobank genetic data linking SNPs that raise prolactin receptor levels to more severe pattern hair loss has now been published; he sees pairing ABS-201 with GLP-1s as a synergy, citing dermatologists' anecdotal reports that 10%, 20% or more of GLP-1 users experience hair loss.
quarterly_data.figure: dermatologists' anecdotes: 10%, 20% or more of GLP-1 users with hair loss
